item.title: New Study Reveals Plant-Rich Diet Outperforms Meat-Heavy Diet In Boosting Gut Health And Reducing Inflammation
item.description: A plant-based diet fosters better gut health than an omnivorous diet, according to a new study. The gut microbiome, a community of trillions of bacteria residing in our digestive system, plays a critical role in overall health. item.title: Recent Survey Reveals Vegan or Plant-Based Population Has Risen to 2 Million in the UK

item.description: The idea of feeding pets a plant-based diet has sparked considerable debate among pet owners, veterinarians, and animal nutrition experts.
